title: A letter, opened
logline: August, two months before the editor: an envelope with a Seattle publisher's mark — a blank shape — on the drafting table, and for the first time in the run, opened. The letter face down beside it. The page shows the tear, not the words.

panels.composition: The drafting table under the lamp: an envelope with a blank shape where a publisher's mark would be, torn open cleanly along the top, and beside it a folded letter face down, a mug on its corner. The pup's nose at the table's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a drafting table under a lamp with an envelope bearing a blank mark torn open cleanly along the top and a folded letter lying face down beside it with a mug set on its corner, a small dog's nose at the table's edge, no words
image.notes: The first opened letter after 2007's shims, 2018's unopened one. Words reserved.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
